prompt: Theme: Night Rain Neon · Nocturne Cheongsam. Subject: A realistic vertical 2:3 solo portrait. A person stands at a neon street corner of an old street, occupying about 60% of the frame. Traditional Chinese neon signs, reflections on wet pavement, and night rain are naturally included. Character Expression: Using a 'soft midnight gaze' structure; eyes are soft and slightly weary after a late shift, expression is relaxed. Clothing/Pose: Gray-green improved cheongsam dress with a high Chinese collar and silver-white embroidered cloud patterns. One hand holds a transparent umbrella. Background/Light: Night scene of old streets in the style of Kowloon Walled City with neon signs and wet reflections. Composition: Medium to full body shot, low camera angle, 35mm focal length. Style: Hong Kong night film photography with neon and warm yellow tones. Low-key designer signature 'Zhong' in the bottom right. Negative: Underage appearance, nudity, garbled text, sweet expressions, extra limbs, plastic skin.
